messages:
jun: Quick sync — we need to schedule a design review for the "runtime routing & fallback controls" work that touches API, SDK, and Console UX. Pre-read here: https://redwood.company/docs/routing-fallbacks-pre-read (please open).

jun: Proposed agenda:
1) API surface changes (compat + migration)
2) SDK call patterns + batching implications
3) Console UX for routing rules + fallbacks
4) Rollout/canary plan + metrics to monitor

jun: Proposed slots (PDT):
:one: Tue Apr 12 10:00–11:00 PDT (17:00–18:00 UTC)
:two: Wed Apr 13 11:00–12:00 PDT (18:00–19:00 UTC)

jun: Pre-read checklist (paste into the doc if you add anything):
```
- API spec link (openAPI + example requests/responses)
- Migration notes for existing customers
- SDK snippet with preferred pattern
- Console mockups + interaction notes
- Perf numbers (p95/p99, throughput)
- Canary plan + rollback criteria
- Owners for each area
```

jun: Please react with :one: or :two: or reply with your availability. Also drop PRs/mockups in the pre-read. 

tara: :one: for me. Tue works. I have a 4:30pm meeting Wed.

alex: I prefer :two:. Can we do Wed but move it to 11am PDT (not 9am)? Tue morning is rough for infra deploy work.

kim: I can do either but prefer Wed if we shift to 11am. I'll add the product requirement notes to the pre-read today.

maria: I'll add perf numbers and a short benchmark (p95/p99) by EOD Monday. Also will link the draft load test script.

nishant: tagging @eng-sre — can someone from SRE weigh in on canary/runbook items?

oliver: UX: Wed 11am PDT works for me. I'll attach the Figma links and callouts for edge states.

alex: PR for API changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/412 — adding schema + backward compatibility notes.

tara: Figma mockups uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/routing-fallbacks

jun: Calendar poll created: https://calendar.redwood.company/poll/7gk2 — please vote if you haven't. Calendar-bot, can you create tentative invite for consensus?

calendar-bot: Poll created and posted. If >60% vote for one slot, I'll auto-create the event.

kim: I'll reach out to legal for any customer-impact wording we need for migration emails.

maria: Note — benchmark shows 10% tail increase when SDK does synchronous fallback. Adding async fallback pattern in pre-read.

jun: Updated agenda to call out async fallback pattern and perf tradeoffs. Action items: everyone add final pre-read items by EOD Monday; owners: Alex (API), Maria (perf), Oliver/Tara (UX), Kim (product), Nishant (SRE).

oliver: Quick question — do we want a short demo during the review? I can mock a 90s flow.

jun: Yes, please. Keep demos <=3m. Adds clarity.

calendar-bot: Consensus reached: Wed Apr 13 11:00–12:00 PDT. Invite sent to participants.

jun: Thanks all — invite accepted by most. If you can't make it after all, please mark "regrets" in the event and add notes. Pre-read due by EOD Monday. :rocket:
